title: Lab Origins: hair restoration serum
text: A brand-origin film that follows a hair serum from the lab bench to the finished bottle
idea: Science sells trust. The ad walks through the making of the product: glassware and vapour, hair under the magnifier, colour swatches and a bottle sketch, then the finished pump bottle and its clean label. By the end, the viewer has seen the work behind it.
why: The lab story builds trust before the product appears.
Ingredients and dose stay readable on the label.
Calm grey and white tones look clinical and premium.
